full_judgment: 11. In the back ground of the facts as discussed above, particularly because of the fact evidenced by the Gazette Notification releasing the land of C.S. Plot Nos. 367 and 369 in C.S. Khatian No. 117 of Mouza Bhola, P.S. Gulshan, Dhaka of the respondent No. 1's vendor, Azizul Huq which were requisitioned in L.A case No. 10 of 1963-64 we find no merit in these appeals, since appellants have no legal basis or footing to lay claim in respect of the land owned by Azizul Huq requisitioned in L.A. Case No. 10 of 1963-64 because of releasing of the land of plots as mentioned above by the Gazette Notification of 11th November, 1999.
